items.title: 1.3.1 Introduction to Software Process Models (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of software process models (PDF 10).

blocks.text: Software process models software development lifecycle ke processes ki ek abstract (khayali, saada) tasveer hain. Yeh software systems banane ki planning, tarteeb (structuring) aur control ke liye ek framework (dhancha) dete hain. Software process models is liye aham hain ke yeh yeh cheezein dete hain:

items: Predictability (pehle se andaza): tay shuda process par chal kar teams nataij ka pehle se andaza laga sakti hain aur khatron (risks) ko behtar sambhal sakti hain.
Efficiency: munazzam tareeqe development ke process ko hamwar karte hain aur bekaar mehnat kam karte hain.
Quality: process model par chalne se quality assurance (quality ki jaanch) ke tareeqe poore development lifecycle mein shamil rehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Software process model par chalne ke teen faide likhein.
blocks.explanation: Predictability (nataij ka andaza aur risks ka behtar intezam), efficiency (kam bekaar mehnat) aur quality (quality assurance shuru se aakhir tak shamil).

items: Process models: development ke processes ki abstract tasveer; planning, structuring aur control ka framework.
